name: python-saga-compensation
title: Sagas with reverse-order compensation and a crash-safe journal
blurb: A saga is a sequence of local transactions with a compensating action each, and the only honest way to run one: steps forward, compensations in reverse, a journal that survives a crash, and an incomplete rollback that says what is still standing. A compensation that keeps failing does not stop the others, a step with no compensation makes the rollback incomplete rather than 'rolled back', and an interrupted step is retried with the same idempotency key instead of being assumed to have worked.
default_description: Run a saga forward, unwind it backwards, and journal every step.
